summary: Sprott Physical Copper Trust filed a Form 6-K to disclose an amended and restated sales agreement with multiple agents, including Cantor Fitzgerald Canada Corporation, Virtu Canada Corp., Canaccord Genuity Corp., and BMO Nesbitt Burns Inc., along with their U.S. affiliates. This agreement allows the trust to issue and sell units from time to time via an at-the-market offering. No specific deal terms, stake percentages, or prices are provided. The filing is a routine capital markets activity constituting an ordinary shelf takedown program. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. What to watch: future equity issuances under this ATM program.
